turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: This is an automated call from Fieldgate Surgery. I'm a computer, not a person, so I'll keep this short. You saw someone here on Tuesday, and the practice asked me to check how you've been getting on since. I won't ask you for your date of birth, your address, your bank details or anything like that. I don't need them, and nobody from the practice will ever ask you for them over the phone. If anyone does, it isn't us. Is now a good time? If it isn't, just say so and I'll leave you be.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Since Tuesday, are you feeling better, about the same, or worse?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Are you getting on alright with what they gave you?

turns.speaker: other
turns.text: Yes, I've been taking them like they said.

turns.speaker: other
turns.text: Only that I've been coughing up blood these last two mornings, but the tablets seem to be helping.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would you like the surgery to see you again?

turns.speaker: other
turns.text: No, I don't think I need to bother anyone.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, Joyce. Someone at the practice will read this today, and if you need another appointment they'll sort that out for you, so you won't have to ring in and wait on hold. Take care.
